# Fly.io Docs

> Fly.io runs full-stack apps and AI workloads on hardware-isolated Machines in regions worldwide. Sprites are persistent Linux VMs for agents and exploratory code. Every link below is a page in Markdown.

- [Fly.io overview](https://fly.io/llms.txt): What Fly.io offers across the product, with links to product pages.
- [Docs page index](https://docs.fly.io/_llms/fly-docs.txt): Index of every docs page, by section. Follow its links until you reach a page.
- [Full docs text](https://docs.fly.io/llms-full.txt): The complete documentation in one file. It's large, so prefer the pages below when you can.

## Get started

- [Getting started](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started/index.md): Begin with Fly.io: the quickstart, hellofly demo, deep dive app, framework guides, and essentials, plus links to Fly Launch, Machines, networking, storage.
- [Quickstart: Launch your app](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started/launch.md): Deploy your first app on Fly.io: install flyctl, sign up or log in, then run fly launch, which generates a Dockerfile and config for most frameworks.
- [Fly.io essentials](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started/essentials.md): Learn the core concepts of Fly.io: Fly Machines, Fly Launch, and Fly Apps, how fly launch, fly.toml, fly deploy, and fly scale fit together, plus a glossary.
- [Get started with your language or framework](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started/get-started-by-framework.md): Pick your stack: Fly Launch scanners detect and deploy Rails, Django, Laravel, Phoenix, Next.js, Go, Rust, .NET, and more, or fall back to any Dockerfile.
- [Migrate from Heroku](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started/migrate-from-heroku.md): Migrate a Heroku app to Fly.io: export config vars, run fly launch, move data to Managed Postgres, set up Redis and workers, then move your custom domain.
- [Troubleshoot your deployment](https://docs.fly.io/getting-started/troubleshooting.md): Fix common Fly.io deployment problems: 502 and 503 errors, failed builds, wrong listen addresses, failing health checks, stuck Machines, and networking issues.
- [Guides and Blueprints](https://docs.fly.io/blueprints/index.md): Architecture patterns and how-to guides for Fly.io: per-user Machines, AI agents, MCP servers, deployments, private networking, scaling, and background jobs.

## Run agents and MCP servers

- [Model Context Protocol](https://docs.fly.io/model-context-protocol/index.md): Run Model Context Protocol servers on Fly.io: fly mcp launch for stdio servers, plus choosing a transport, deploy method, host, and access control.
- [Launch an MCP Server with fly mcp launch](https://docs.fly.io/model-context-protocol/launch.md): fly mcp launch deploys an npx, uvx, go run, or Docker stdio MCP server to a Fly Machine and configures your client; fly mcp inspect and destroy follow.
- [flyctl mcp server](https://docs.fly.io/model-context-protocol/flyctl-server.md): Add the flyctl MCP server to Claude, Cursor, or Zed with fly mcp server, see which flyctl commands it supports, test in MCP inspector, or run it remotely.
- [Fly agent setup](https://docs.fly.io/model-context-protocol/setup-agent.md): Set up Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents for Fly.io in one command. fly setup agent installs the Fly skills and the hosted Fly MCP server.
- [Fly agent skills](https://docs.fly.io/model-context-protocol/agent-skills.md): Install the Fly.io agent skills into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents with fly skills install, then update, pin, or remove them.

## Build and run apps

- [Apps on Fly.io](https://docs.fly.io/apps/index.md): Fly Apps docs hub: Fly Launch for deploying and scaling, runtime and build secrets, and production guides on availability, tuning, and concurrency.
- [Fly Launch](https://docs.fly.io/launch/index.md): Create, configure, deploy, and scale apps with Fly Launch on Fly.io using fly launch, fly.toml, fly deploy, and fly scale, plus autostop and GitHub Actions.
- [Language & Framework Guides](https://docs.fly.io/languages-and-frameworks/index.md): Every language guide for Fly.io: in-depth docs for Elixir, Rails, Laravel, Django, JS, Rust and Python, plus starters for Go, .NET, Crystal and WordPress.
- [Deploy with a Dockerfile](https://docs.fly.io/languages-and-frameworks/dockerfile.md): Deploy an app from your own Dockerfile on Fly.io with fly launch, then add env vars to fly.toml, set secrets, and redeploy with fly deploy.

## Machines

- [Fly Machines](https://docs.fly.io/machines/index.md): Start here for Fly Machines, fast-launching VMs on Fly.io. Find the Machines introduction, the REST API, and flyctl commands for running and updating Machines.
- [An introduction to Fly Machines](https://docs.fly.io/machines/overview.md): Get to know Fly Machines, the fast-launching VMs behind Fly.io: run one with fly machine run, follow the lifecycle, scale by clone or update, and pick regions.
- [Machines API](https://docs.fly.io/machines/api/index.md): Manage apps, Machines, volumes, certificates and tokens with the Fly.io Machines REST API. Find each resource reference, the OpenAPI spec and the fly-go client.

## Data and storage

- [Managed Postgres](https://docs.fly.io/postgres/index.md): Get an overview of Fly.io Managed Postgres: backups, high availability, pgvector and PostGIS, storage, regions, features in development, and plan pricing.
- [Databases and storage](https://docs.fly.io/database-storage-guides.md): Pick a data option on Fly.io: Managed Postgres, Upstash for Redis, Fly Volumes for persistent NVMe disk, Tigris object storage, or an external provider.
- [Fly Volumes overview](https://docs.fly.io/volumes/overview.md): Understand Fly Volumes, local NVMe storage for Fly.io Machines: one per Machine, placement, encryption, sizing, IOPS limits, forks, snapshots and redundancy.
- [Tigris Global Object Storage](https://docs.fly.io/tigris/index.md): Create S3-compatible Tigris object storage buckets on Fly.io with fly storage create, connect via the endpoint, CLI or SDKs, and migrate from another provider.

## Networking and security

- [Networking](https://docs.fly.io/networking/index.md): Fly.io networking docs: Anycast public services, 6PN private networking, Flycast, egress IPs, fly-replay routing, custom domains, UDP, and TLS.
- [Public Network Services](https://docs.fly.io/networking/services.md): Set up public networking for a Fly.io app: Anycast IPv6, shared and dedicated IPv4, HTTP, TLS and PROXY protocol handlers, HTTPS redirects and outbound IPs.
- [Private Networking](https://docs.fly.io/networking/private-networking.md): Connect apps over the private 6PN network on Fly.io using .internal DNS, and link your laptop or outside services to it with a WireGuard VPN from flyctl.
- [Custom domains](https://docs.fly.io/networking/custom-domain.md): Point your own domain at a Fly.io app with fly certs add, set A, AAAA or CNAME records, validate the TLS certificate, and fix Cloudflare certificate issues.
- [Dynamic Request Routing with fly-replay](https://docs.fly.io/networking/dynamic-request-routing.md): Route requests on Fly.io between regions, Machines, or apps with the fly-replay response header, including JSON replays, replay caching, and fly-force-region.
- [Security](https://docs.fly.io/security/index.md): Fly.io security docs: org roles, SSO, member offboarding, TLS termination, Arcjet, access tokens, OpenID Connect, and shared responsibility.
- [Access tokens](https://docs.fly.io/security/tokens.md): Create Fly.io access tokens scoped to one app or org, including SSH, machine-exec and read-only tokens, then set expiry, list and revoke them with fly tokens.

## Monitoring

- [Monitoring on Fly.io](https://docs.fly.io/monitoring/index.md): Fly.io monitoring docs: managed Prometheus and Grafana metrics, Sentry error tracking, and guides to live tail, log search, the logs API, and export.
- [Logging overview](https://docs.fly.io/monitoring/logging-overview.md): See how Fly.io app logs flow from stdout through Vector and NATS, then live tail with fly logs, use the Logs API, search logs in Grafana, or export them.
- [Metrics on Fly.io](https://docs.fly.io/monitoring/metrics.md): Monitor apps with managed Prometheus and Grafana on Fly.io: query built-in proxy, instance, volume and Postgres metrics, add alerts, and expose custom metrics.

## Reference

- [Fly.io reference](https://docs.fly.io/reference/index.md): Fly.io reference index: architecture, regions, Machine migration, flyctl, fly.toml, Fly Proxy, autostop, health checks, builders, load balancing.
- [flyctl - The Fly.io CLI](https://docs.fly.io/flyctl/index.md): flyctl is the Fly.io CLI. Start here for the core fly commands: auth signup and login, launch, deploy, apps, secrets, logs, status, releases, ips, certs.
- [Install flyctl](https://docs.fly.io/flyctl/install.md): Install flyctl on macOS with Homebrew or the install script, on Linux with curl, or on Windows with PowerShell, and how to uninstall it later.
- [App configuration (fly.toml)](https://docs.fly.io/reference/configuration.md): Configure a Fly.io app in fly.toml: build settings, deploy strategy, env vars, http_service and services, mounts, VM size, checks, processes, statics and files.
- [Fly Proxy](https://docs.fly.io/reference/fly-proxy.md): Understand how Fly Proxy routes public and Flycast traffic on Fly.io, plus load balancing, connection handlers, autostop/autostart, and fly-replay routing.
- [Regions](https://docs.fly.io/reference/regions.md): Find every Fly.io region code, see which regions have WireGuard gateways or host Managed Postgres, and check where your app runs with fly status.

## Pricing and support

- [Fly.io Resource Pricing](https://docs.fly.io/about/pricing.md): See what Fly.io bills for, from Machines and volumes to Managed Postgres, data transfer, IPs, SSL, support plans and extensions, with sample app costs.
- [Fly.io Billing](https://docs.fly.io/about/billing.md): Understand how Fly.io bills each organization monthly: Machine, volume and snapshot charges, invoices, unified billing, payment options, and account deletion.
- [Fly.io Free Trial](https://docs.fly.io/about/free-trial.md): Check what the Fly.io free trial includes, the $1 credit and its limits, how to track your balance, and what happens when the credit runs out.
- [Support](https://docs.fly.io/about/support.md): Get help with Fly.io through the community forum, billing email, paid email support and Support Portal, and see what to include in a ticket and what's in scope.

## Sprites

- [Sprites overview](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/index.md): Persistent, hardware-isolated Linux VMs.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/quickstart.md): Install the sprite CLI, sign in, and create a Sprite.
- [Working with Sprites](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/working-with-sprites.md): Day-to-day use of the sprite CLI.
- [Checkpoints](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/concepts/checkpoints.md): Snapshot and restore a Sprite's filesystem.
- [Connectors](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/concepts/connectors.md): Let Sprites call GitHub, OpenRouter, or any HTTP API.
- [Lifecycle and persistence](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/concepts/lifecycle.md): How a Sprite moves between states.
- [Sprite networking](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/concepts/networking.md): How traffic reaches a Sprite.
- [CLI commands](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/cli/commands.md): Every sprite CLI command and flag.
- [Remote MCP server](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/integrations/remote-mcp.md): Point any MCP client at sprites.dev/mcp.
- [Integrations](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/integrations/index.md): Agent plugins, SDKs, and platform integrations.

## APIs

- [Machines API overview](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/index.md): Base URL, auth, and links to each resource.
- [Machines API models](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/models.md): Schema reference for every Machines API object.
- [Machines API OpenAPI spec](https://docs.fly.io/api/machines/openapi.json): Every endpoint, machine-readable.
- [Sprites API OpenAPI spec](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/openapi.json): Every REST endpoint, machine-readable.
- [Sprites API AsyncAPI spec](https://docs.fly.io/sprites/api/asyncapi.json): Every WebSocket endpoint, machine-readable.
